ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT($Setup.RES_Config_Switch__c.RES_Validation_Rules_Off__c), OR( AND( NOT(ISPICKVAL(RES_Tax_Category__c, "")), ISBLANK(RES_Tax_Number__c) ), AND( NOT(ISBLANK(RES_Tax_Number__c)), OR( LEN(RES_Tax_Number__c) <> 15, LEFT(RES_Tax_Number__c, 1) <> "3", RIGHT(RES_Tax_Number__c, 1) <> "3" ) ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Tax Number is required when a Tax Category is selected. It must be 15 digits, starting and ending with "3".
